script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet and Earth element, is squaring Saturn tightly, and this is shaking your 8th House of shared money and deep intimacy. If you're single, your 7th House of partnerships is calling you toward a loyal, magnetic connection that feels safe and exciting. If you're taken, watch for stubborn arguments about financial control and emotional independence. Your 6th House of health may flare if you skip rest, so honor your body. Your 10th House of career is also feeling this pressure, so steady, practical effort matters more than bold shortcuts now. Your 2nd House of personal values may need honest boundaries around money. Avoid risky investments and prideful spending, but an unexpected blessing may arrive through a trusted friend. This is not the moment for impulsive decisions, Taurus. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
